balls.text: that is unlucky for Jordan, but Pollard will take it. Goes wide on the crease, bowls a big bouncer, Pollard pulls, gets a top edge, over the wicketkeeper
Jordan goes wide and full again, and this time Pollard nails his attempted hit over long-on. Such clean crisp hitting

wide full, might be a wide if he doesn't play it, but Pollard drags it to long-on. Takes the second, the throw has overtaken him as he turns around, but the ball is losing pace, and Pollard is gaining it. Easily makes the second
nearly a yorker, outside off, Coulter-Nile does enough to bring Pollard back on strike
he is going leg side every ball. Drags this length ball smack back at his batting partner. NCN ducks, saves himself, then runs the single
that is massive. Jordan bowls the bouncer outside off, hoping to make him cut to the big part of the field, but Pollard moves across to pull this clean out of the ground
short ball with short fine in the circle. The same mistake as Arshdeep. Trying not to be predictable, trying not to give way the ball with the field set, but it goes over short fine for four
yorker, dipping on him, 144ks, just outside off. So unlucky not to hit the off stump. It just moves away an inch after pitching
slower short ball, makes him hit into the big side of the ground, and Coulter-Nile doesn't get all of it, but he has managed to place it in front of deep backward square leg
slower ball, on a length, and it beats the slog as it stays low

bouncer, COulter-Nile swings hard at the pull, and the top edge travels a million miles in the air before falling in  no man's land on the leg side. All fielders there are on the fence except short fine, but this has gone in front of square
yorker, middle and leg, but the inside edge goes past short fine leg for two
full, just outside off, can't get under this, driven to long-off for one
this is crunched away. Looks for the wide yorker again, misses it, and Coulter-Nuile not only drives it hard but also beats deep cover to his left

that is just rotten luck. A sharp bouncer, which hits the bat instead of bat making any move towards hitting it. In fact NCN is preserving his self and looking to sway away. The top edge, though, flies over short fine
gets the wide yorker right this time. Steered to third man for one

goes for the wide yorker, trying to make him hit to the bigger boundary on the off side, but Pollard shuffles across, takes this on the full and goes over wide mid-on, the shortest boundary in play. Another yorker missed. Young man must be intimidated
and this is an intimidating start. Bowls full, on-pace, outside off. Has missed the yorker and bowled a half-volley. Pollard drills it over long-off for a six
strays down with a length ball, bunted into the big side of the ground, comes back for two, handing the strike over to POllard for the start of the next over
on a length, outside off, punched to cover
short of a length, wide outside off, punched to deep cover for one

the slowness of the pitch showing. This is a length ball, into the pads, something de Kock loves to pick-up over the leg side. But this has come off the bottom of the bat, and he caught at deep square
walks at Jordan, who bowls it short of a length, and he opens the face to pick up a single
nearly a yorker, de Kock can't get under it. Single to long-on
short of a length, outside off, Pollard looks to run this down to third man but is beaten
bouncer, outside off, a disinterested leave from Pollard
full and straight, clipped off the toes for a single to deep midwicket
hard length. Shami bowls the only thing that works against Hardik Pandya
bouncer, pulled away crisply, but gets just a single to deep midwicket
short of a length, outside off, hit hard to long-on for one
full, outside leg, drilled to deep midwicket
fifty for de Kock, fourth in last five outings. Driven to long-off as he pitches this up
wrong'un, outside off, punched to cover
lovely clean swing. Doesn't matter which way you are turning if you bowl a plum half-volley. He goes over long-on for a flat six
lovely shot. Wrong'un, around off, and he manages to cut this up and over cover. Not enough room to be doing that, but he still manages to do so
full, on off, driven hard and back to Ashwin

this is why we love Pandya. It doesn't matter if it is the first ball. If it has to go, it has to go. Bishnoi bowls a little too full, and Pandya launches him over wide long-off. The head stays down and doesn't look at where the ball is going
full, outside leg, Pandya tries the sweep, but this comes off the toe end for a smart catch for Hooda at deep square leg
is this a legbreak?. De Kock is looking to make room and cut, but is cramped, and just survives thanks to his pad
powerful sweep but there is a deep midwicket in place to keep this down to one
on a length, wrong'un, he punches this, but straight to point
too full, just outside leg, driven down to long-on
wrong'un, on a length, punched to cover, who is tight, saving the single
full, middle and leg, pushed to leg
Rahul blindsighted by the batsman moving around in the crease. De Kock switches his stance, Ashwin goes wide outside off, but Rahul fails to go with the turn, which is further away. Four byes
tries the big drive down the ground, and he is playing for the wrong'un. Still gets an outside edge for a single to short third man
short, too short, and pitches this outside leg too. Pulled away over midwicket
full, slow, dipping, driven back to him
looks for the reverse-hit, gives up his cards early, and Bishno pitches this well outside what would have been his leg stump. Just the single to what would have been his long-off
another wrong'un, and Pandya seems to have picked it as he goes towards wide long-off, but is beaten
on a length, skidding on, wrong'un again, dabbed out, just to the left of cover
looks for the reverse sweep on the googly, but only gets a glove to short third man
wrong'un, on a length, around off, defended from the crease
on a length, going with the angle, pushed into the off side
short of a length again, hardly any turn, punched to deep cover for one
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep cover
too short, and doesn't matter if you are an offspinner or a legspinner if you bowl that length to de Kock. He sits back, swivels, and pulls this over square leg
Pandya skips down the track, Hooda slips in a quicker delivery, hits the pad, but is going down leg
short of a length, just outside off, Pandya plays the late-cut, but Ashwin makes a diving save at point
on a length, angling in, no turn, worked to leg
too much width with this wrong'un, and Pandya plays it smartly, delaying the cut shot, deliberately going to the right of point, not giving deep cover any chance
and another googly. Short of a length, gives him some width, but just the single to deep cover
wrong'un again, short of a length, outside off, mis-hit back to Ashwin
tossed up this time, driven with an open face to sweeper-cover
edged wide of Gayle at slip. Another wrong'un, quite quick, Pandya looks to cut again, gets a healthy edge too wide of Gayle
starts with a wrong'un. On a length, Pandya looks to cut, but is beaten by the turn away
nicely bowled, tossed up, still quick, at 95ks. Defended with an open face
full, into the pads, uppishly driven to long-on for one
short of a length, no room, punched to deep midwicket for one
on a length, angling in, defended to leg

lovely shot, but not so sure about Jordan's effort in the deep. Maxwell tosses it up again, and he drives it over extra cover. Jordan, running from long-off, is within diving distance but chooses not to
slower through the air, 93ks, middle and off, defended back to him
full, outside off, hit too hard to mid-off to be coming through for one
full, outside off, crunched, but straight to extra cover, who is off the circle to prevent the single
bouncer, into his body, mis-hit past Jordan for one
lovely shot. This is high-quality hitting. Seriously. It is short of a length, around the waist, and he has still managed to drive this on the up and over extra for a six no less. Incredible shot
short of a length, no room again, pushed towards short straight extra cover
short of a length, angling in, defended to leg
round-arm, on a length, around off, de Kock is done in by the lack of turn. Gets an inside edge onto the pad

slower through the air, no turn, Pandya defends, the ball bounces in the vicinity of the toe, and then through to Rahul. Maxwell appeals for the catch, claiming it has hit the toe on the full. This is not even close to the toe. Bat to pad to ground to Rahul. Carry on
slower through the air, no turn, Pandya defends, the ball bounces near his toe, and then bounces off the toe. Maxwell appeals for the catch
quick length ball, no room, defended to cover
full, outside off, driven down to long-off for one
Midhun: "Bit misfield runs are in bowlers quota too..even without it being his mistake "
better delivery. On a length, on off, holding its line. Defended with an open face
lovely shot. Slightly shorter than the last ball, slightly wider, and de Kock swings his arms through it. On the up, along the ground, through extra cover
stays on a length, not much room, driven on the up, but straight to backward point
on a length, on off, defended off the front foot
short of a length, outside off, steered to third man

one more wicket for Arsh. Short, wide, Kishan tries to cut this square, but the extra bounce from his height means it gets a little big on him, and he fails to control it. The top edge settles with deep third man
no turn this time, fired into the pads, and Kishan takes the single this time
turn, sharp turn. Looks like an easy single to leg, but then it turns to take the leading edge to point
short of a length, speared in, and because it sits up, it gives Kishan time to hit it down the ground and wide of mid-on
stays full, just short of the slot, and is pushed for one to long-off
full and outside off again, driven to long-off again
full, outside off, driven down the ground

four overthrows from Pooran. Short of a length, outside off, played towards point for an easy single. Pooran, though, still has a go at the stumps and the man backing up is square and deep on the leg side. This throw ends up towards midwicket, and his dive is not enough to keep this in
short ball, gets big on him, he doesn't get all of the pull but manages to keep it down. Just the single to midwicket
on a length, wicket to wicket, inside edge onto the pad

caught on the rebound. Yadav whips away a full straight ball, but doesn't get enough power or elevation in it. The bat face closes early. M Ashwin is off the 30-yard circle so it keeps quickly at him. It hits the hands and pops up for an easy rebound
length ball, angling in, Yadav shuffles a little and defends this to mid-on
short of a length, outside off, opens the face, guides it to slip on the bounce

right across it and plays all around. Big lbw shout, but this is a length ball that has not swung. So it is unlikely that this has pitched within the stumps and is going on to hit. And because this is hitting, it is pretty certain this has been pitched outside leg

timbahhh. Arshdeep gets Rohit Sharma. Looks like a legcutter to me, but it isn't. He has bowled seam-up and on-pace. Short of a length, not too much room, and Sharma looks to run this down. Too close to his body, and he plays on
short of a length, no room, dabs down on it, gets a single towards short third man
that is feeding de Kock's strengths. On a length, down the leg side, on-pace, and he plays his piack-up shot from inside the crease
on a length, no room, defended back to him
slightly harsh call. Short ball, into the arm pit, de Kock gets inside the line and misses. Called a wide down the leg side
on a length, on off, defended solidly back to Arshdeep
lovely seam movement. On a length, just outside off, and then jags back in to trap Sharma on the crease. Just gets an inside edge
short of a length, outside off, bottom edge on the attempted cut
strays down the pads. There is some seam movement from a pretty tight line. Sharma nicely glances it fine of fine leg. Arshdeep Singh puts in a dive but can't keep it in
full and straight, swinging down, clipped away off the toe
short of a length, just outside off, angling across, gets the bottom edge on the cut
short, wide, angling in, but de Kock stays back to use the pace and late-cut it past point
quick length ball across him, pushed to point, and they don't run on the misfield
nearly run out. Pushed to the adjacent pitch on the leg side, Maxwell dashes across, de Kock is well short, but he misses with the direct hit
gets some room with a length ball outside off, and he places it between cover-point and extra cover for a four
quick length ball, into the pads, defended
full, outside off, driven to extra cover, sent back as Sharma charges off
on a length, middle and leg, punched away to deep midwicket

yorker, swinging in, and there is a third umpire checking the striker's end. And we have a super over by the barest of margins. A second super over. Jordan's running is suspect here. he has turned around in a big circle, and is running two pitches off the main pitch. He has lost at least four yards doing that, and he has been beaten by an inch. Yorker, dug out, reaches the 30-yard circle towards long-on. Pollard comes in with the big throw to the keeper, but Jordan has brought on yet another Super Over
full and wide, and this might have been wide had he not got bat on it. Single to deep point
good umpiring. Hooda moves across the line, Bouls goes behind him with a yorker. Misses the yorker by a stump's width. Hooda wants a wide, but it is not called
slower ball, on a length, outside off, shovelled to long-on for one. Keeps it along the ground
oh finally some luck for KXIP. Pinpoint yorker, Jordan makes room, gets an inside edge past the keeper. Oh sweet relief, they must be thinking
Jordan does look to take that route but this slower short ball squeezes under his attempted pull
full and straight, pushed straight of long-on. Smart again. Soft hands too. Pollard has to run to his left and also in towards the ball. They take an easy two

this is ordinary bowling really. Finally goes on-pace but well down the leg side with short fine leg up. This is poor execution in elite sport. Can't bowl half-volleys down leg with short fine leg in the circle. Tickled away for four

dropped at short fine leg. Oh this is not a good ball. Short of a length, slower, but down the leg side, and all Hooda has to do is clear short fine. But he doesn't get enough bat on this, and offers Chahar a sitter, head-high to his left. He spills it
smart shot. Short of a length, on top of off, but Hooda makes room and plays the late-cut, bisecting short third man and backward point
slower ball, short of a length, outside off, he pulls this wide of long-on for two
slower ball, 123ks, full and wide, driven crisply, but straight to extra cover
low full toss again, he moves across to work this to deep midwicket for one
full and straight, a low full toss, pushed towards long-on for one

bowled'im. Oh Bumrah. That piece of magic upsets all calculations and plans. What a piece of bloody magic. Yorker at 149ks to peg the off stumps back. And that is not all. It seems Rahul has the line covered, but it seems it shapes away late to beat his outside edge and then hit the wicket. Oh man, what a bowler Bumrah is
full toss, quick, ow, hit straight to extra cover. Sharma feels the pinch. Takes the risk of a direct hit. Rahul is alert. He doesn't over-run. Comes back for the overthrow
Hooda swings hard, doesn't get all of it, will take a single to deep midwicket
short of a length, slower ball, outside off, steered for one to short third man
short of a length, outside off, beaten on the cut. Sharp pace here
slower ball, short of a length, shovelled to deep square leg for one
lovely shot. Coulter-Nile misses his yorker by six inches or a foot, and Rahul stays deep in the crease to go inside-out and in front of deep cover for four
short of a length, into the pitch, slower, pulled wide of long-on. Pollard puts a dive in, but can't deny them the second
on a length, angling in, pushed wide of long-on. Easy two

you are looking for eight, you get 15. Bouncer at his badge, but unlike Pooran, Hooda manages to get inside the line of this. That bouncer was over the leg stumps, this is outside off. Hooda gets inside the line and pulls hard. The short boundary does the rest
slower ball, full and wide, driven to deep cover for one
short of a length, wide, with no deep point. That is a rare bad ball from Bumrah. Rahul cuts it perfectly into the gap. That is eight off this over
another slower ball, wide again, this time he catches up with it, but can't pierce the gap between point and short third man
slower ball, wide outside off, well wide. Called too
short of a length, outside off, pushed wide of cover for one
short of a length, into the pads, worked square of deep midwicket for two
round-arm, short of a length, into the pads, pushed towards deep midwicket for one
down the wicket, Pandya pulls the length back, he bunts this to leg for one
doesn't miss out on this full toss. This is wide outside off, and he goes square of deep cover. All along the ground. Beats him
oh misses out. Really missed out. A full toss down the leg side, all he needs is a tickle, but he tickes it too well, and sends it straight to short fine leg
makes room, Pandya fires this in, punched straight to cover, who is in on the single
down the wicket, Pandya fires this in quick, Rahul places this wide of deep midwicket for two
short of a length, wide, cut away to deep cover
full outside off, driven to deep cover for one
length-ball quick legbreak, defended off the back foot
slip takes out Maxwell
too full outside off, drilled to deep cover for one
Rahul takes on the loose ball. His fifth fifty comes up with a pull off a rank long hop. This is just a gift
quick length ball, 147ks, outside off, defended to mid-off
Bumrah delivers again
slightly fuller, but not driving length by any means. Bowled at 141ks. Pushed back to him
on a length, 138ks, just outside off, defended from the crease
short ball, sharp, gets big on him, takes the top edge on the pull, but doesn't carry to deep square leg
top-quality shot, short of a length, angling in towards top of off, but he punches it on the up, and in front of deep cover
Just the over MI needed. The last bundary-less over brought a wicket in the next over
goes back to punch this length ball to long-on. Hurried into the shot because this is not short enough
slower loopy legbreak, just inside the wide line. Left alone
wrong'un, outside off, cut away to deep cover
fuller, straighter, pushed down to long-on for one
ice legbreak outside off, turns away to beat him but not wide enough to be called
this is the Pooran show. Submit to it. After a four into the big side of the ground, he shuffles across to play the pick-up shot over the shorter leg boundary
lovely shot. Singeing the turf as it travels to the extra-cover fence. A rare on-pace ball from Pollard, and he drives it on the up and square of deep cover
short of a length, wide, nicely cut away in front of deep point for two
slower ball again, hit straight to deep midwicket for one
short of a length, slower ball, Rahul walks at him and places this square of deep midwicket for two
nearly caught and bowled. Slower ball, Rahul early into the shot, but it reaches Pollard on the half-volley
nicely done. After the six off the tossed-up delivery, he is back and waiting for the quicker one. Just turns out that this is turning down leg, and he guides it fine of fine leg
Pooran announces himself. Has he picked the wrong'un? At any rate, he has gone over long-off. And this is just a touch too full, and he goes over long-off. Powerful hit
tossed up, seems like the slider, defended back to him
full and straight, doesn't turn, runs off the inside half of the bat for one
quick legbreak first up, into the pads, worked to leg for one

Gayle looks to take on long-on off a spinner. Nearly goes over him, but this is a low-percentage shot. This is a slider, short and wide outside off, and instead of cutting it, he is looking to loft him over long-off. Not enough pace to work with. Caught at long-off
full and straight, driven back to Coulter-Nile. Just the over MI needed
wide length ball, can't get power into this. Just the single to deep cover
on a length, angling in, worked to deep midwicket for another single
Rahul looking to give himself room, totally done in by the sower short ball, gets a bottom edge to point
short of a length, into the body, tucked away for one
slower ball, middle and leg, clipped to deep midwicket for one
wrong'un, punched to point, Rahul wants the quick single, but Gayle sends him back
slow sweep into the big side of the ground. Not often do you see Gayle sweep. And he has placed this straight of deep square leg
full outside off, Gayle looks for the six over long-off, but the outside edge flies over cover for two more
swept, uses his pace, places this square of short fine. Comes back for two
no wrong'un first up. The quick legbreak again. Defended
quick legbreak, on a length, goes back to punch this to deep cover
slower ball again, but this is short, and it beats his pull

and this is why he was trying to stay out of Gayle's reach. he bowls straight, overpitches slightly, and Gayle lofts this over long-on. Not the cleanest of Gayle strikes, but this ground is not big enough
wide on the crease, full, angling in, drilled to the left of long-on, and Boult puts in the dive to save two runs. Oh sorry, they run just the one. So three runs saved
wide on the crease, full, angling in, drilled to the left of long-on, and Boult puts in the dive to save two runs
length ball, angling in, driven hard, on the up, for a single to long-on
wide outside off, trying to stay out of his reach. Too wide
slower-ball offcutter, middle and leg, grips. Defended back to him
full, straight and slow, clipped to deep midwicket for one
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep point for one
smashed away. Not short at all. I mean not pullable short. This is just short of a length, and he pulls this off the front foot and over midwicket
full, just outside off, drilled to mid-off
short, doesn't get high, and Rahul swivels to pull this over square leg. It is actually not very short, and he has pulled this off the front foot
on a length, around off, Rahul looks to drive on the up, but the ball hits the outer half of the bat and runs to point
Boult gets another over at the top. His third
short of a length, into the hip, tucked away to short fine
slower bouncer, a good'un. Gayle is preparing for the hook but then sees the pace and aborts. he knows a quicker bouncer flies off the top edge, but a slower one doesn't
menacing front foot planted down the wicket, looking for anything that allows him to swing his arms through. NCN doesn't allow him that. He defends this length ball
it is boss time, you betcha. He is down the wicket, turns this into a lenght ball, and lofts this sweetly over long-on for a massive six
on a length, around off, hits him high on the bat as he defends with an open face
on a length, outside off, left alone as it angles across
fuller, straighter, pushed wide of cover for a quick single to break the maiden
holds the line against the angle again. This is just short of a length, closer to off, and it beats the outside edge and bounces over the off stump
on a length, outside off, 143ks, then holds its line against the angle. A Test-match delivery. Beats him

bowled'im. Bumrah intervenes just in time after yet another KXIP rollicking start. Short of a length, moving in, hits the inside edge, then the pad, then the top of the middle stump to tickle the bail off
short of a length, no room, defended off the back foot
full, outside off, hit to mid-on. Hit to hard so Agarwal sends Rahul back. The call is loud and clear
looking for the yorker, bowls just a full ball, and Rahul stays deep in the crease to drive this between the non-striker and mid-off. Slower ball gone wrong
sharp bouncer, perhaps the reaction of a man who had run in and was not allowed to bowl. A touch too high, though
lovely shot. This is the good Rahul, and we all love the good Rahul. Slower ball, half-volley, and he goes inside-out over cover for a flat six
full and straight, whipped to midwicket
shot of a man who has been in great form. Boult goes short, he pulls this off the front foot, and well over midwicket
misfielded at cover-point. Looks like it is Chahar. Rahul stays leg side of the ball and hits this hard towards cover-point. It has gone straight to Chahar, who has not judged the bounce well at all
short of a length, straight, tucked away off the hip
quick length ball, just outside off, pushed straight to short cover
angled into the pads, worked to leg

great effort from Yadav but can't latch on. A nothing chip from Agarwal when he is not to the pitch of the ball. It is travelling wide of mid-on, will take a big dive, Yadav puts it in, and is hit on the wrist, which means he has actually dived too far. That is some effort
on a length, outside off, defended with an open face
short of a length, doesn't come on, Rahul is looking to hit midwicket but ends up dragging this to square leg
Now the specific Mumbai Indians plans. Krunal Pandya to share the new ball
top edge on the pull, but this one lands safe of long leg
on a length, outside off, pushed with an open face, past point
short, at him keeps the pull down. Single
Boult is the only one appealing. Sharma doesn't listen to him. Oh he has hit this. Boult is the only one in an empty stadium to have heard this
Agarwal looks in great touch. Boult doesn't swing this one, bowls on a length, angles it across, and he helps it on its way over short third man
and he swings this back in, looking for that pad, but Rahul is good enough to clip this to leg for one
